name: unity-dev-skills
description: Claude Code skills for building Unity games with AI coding agents, starting with a one-pass setup that gives agents the structure and ground rules to work on their own.

plugins.name: unity-project-setup
plugins.description: Prepares a Unity project for AI-agent-driven development: layered asmdefs the compiler enforces, standard folders, Editor-applied project settings, Unity git files, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md with a docs/ set agents keep current, coding/commit/collaboration rules, a tested EventBus and a commit workflow skill.
